name: pierced-membrane
why: A blind hole stopping 0.004 mm short of the top face leaves a membrane 0.004 thick between two parallel planes that share no edge. The disc is large on this plate, so a sweep lands on it too; the case pins that the face-pair search reads it to the micron at 200 samples, and that a ball this small stays a wall: it is taken for an edge only against a face its own face meets.
